content.title: Community & Economic Development
content.summary: The Community and Economic Development Work System in Arvada aims to enhance the quality of life by ensuring development aligns with design values, safety standards, and economic needs. It focuses on providing affordable housing, preserving neighborhoods, creating jobs, and supporting local businesses through various divisions, including Building Safety, Economic Development, Housing, and Planning. The department emphasizes collaboration with the community to guide growth and maintain the city's economic health.
content.body:
## Mission

The mission of the Community and Economic Development Work System is to enhance the quality of life for the Arvada community by ensuring development meets design values and standards, safety requirements, infrastructure needs, and supports the local economy.

## Vision

The vision of Community and Economic Development is to cultivate a thriving, dynamic and diverse community by providing a customer experience that transcends expectations through our intentional collaboration, inclusion and progressive practices.

## About

Community and Economic Development sustains a planned and balanced community that provides affordable housing while preserving existing neighborhoods and the related housing stock; enhances the image of the community; provides quality jobs for citizens; generates additional revenue and ensure the economic health and financial stability for the City of Arvada; and coordinates development activities to conform with city policies and regulations.

The Department strives to work collaboratively with the community to guide growth and revitalization throughout the City of Arvada.

## Building Safety Division

Building services includes permits, inspections and plan review for Commercial, Industrial, and Residential developments and alterations by ensuring conformance with the adopted Building Codes with amendments. [Read more about the Building Safety Division >](https://www.arvadaco.gov/188/Building-Services)

## Economic Development Division

The Arvada Economic Development Association (AEDA) is the official organization within the City of Arvada that supports business. AEDA's mission is to provide business and commercial development services to new and existing businesses, so they can grow and expand to create jobs, increase revenues, and make capital investments. [Read more about AEDA >](https://www.arvadaco.gov/689/Arvada-Economic-Development-Association-)

## Housing Division

The Housing Division and Arvada Housing Authority work together with local partners to improve housing affordability in Arvada. The division provides a number of different tools to the community, including grants, vouchers and other opportunities. [Read more about the Housing Division >](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1155/Affordable-Housing-in-Arvada)

## Planning Division

The Planning division evaluates development plans to ensure they conform with the Land Development Code and Comprehensive Plan. The team also oversees long-range planning in the city, developing plans, policies and programs to guide the physical design and development of the City of Arvada. [Read more about the Planning Division >](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1369/Planning-and-Development)

## Systems and Administration

Behind the scenes, a team of administrators provides customer and staff support to CED, working closely with residents and developers to ensure our review and development processes run smoothly and efficiently.
